claims.text: A verdict under Spec 036 states only whether the registered criterion for PRED-2026-011 is met.
claims.boundary: Scope claim for the whole spec. The registered prediction (docs/PREDICTION_REGISTER.md, PRED-2026-011) is the input, not a question; a verdict is a statement about the registered criterion on the registered data. It does not govern the step-0 checks (C04-C06, C09), the computation (C10-C11), or the register handling (C14). What the signs mean, why they pattern as they do, stability at any other site, and the positional behaviour of P000 are never judged under this spec.
alternatives: A scored prediction may be read as evidence about the script's decipherment or about sign meanings.
falsification_tests: Any Spec 036 outcome statement claiming more than the registered criterion's outcome on the registered data defeats this claim.

metadata.boundary_confirmation: C01 states this spec's scope (the registered criterion's outcome); C13 states the verdict wording's permitted independence claim and its required caveats. The two govern different objects - this study's outputs, and the wording of those outputs - and are consistent by construction: a verdict inside scope is exactly one whose wording claims only what C13 permits. Neither negates the other.

claims.text: The success criterion is the registered one: at least 70% of the trained INITIAL signs show a Harappa start rate of at least 0.40.
claims.boundary: The criterion claim (the register's, restated as a definition of the pass line). The share's possible values are 0, 1/2, and 1; the 70% bar is met only by 1. It does not govern how a start rate is computed (C10), the zero-occurrence edge (C11), or the unmappable closure (C09), each of which is stated in its own claim.
alternatives: The bar could be read as approximate, or a 1-of-2 result could be reported as substantially meeting it.
falsification_tests: Any Spec 036 product that reports a 1-of-2 (or lower) share as meeting the criterion, or that applies any bar other than 70% at 0.40, defeats this claim.

metadata.strongest_rival: The bar could be read as approximate, or a 1-of-2 result could be reported as substantially meeting it.
metadata.verdict_rule: The pass line is 70% of trained signs at start rate 0.40 or above; with 2 signs, only 2 of 2 passes.
metadata.boundary_confirmation: C02 defines the pass line; C10 defines the quantity the line applies to (the share of trained signs at or above 0.40). The two are consistent by construction: C10 computes the share C02 judges. Neither negates the other. C02 defines the pass line; C04 governs the step-0 reproduction that must pass before any scoring. The two are consistent by construction: the reproduction judges the trained set and the screen, never the criterion, and the criterion is applied only after the reproduction passes. Neither negates the other. C02 defines the pass line over the share; C11 states how one mappable sign with zero occurrences counts toward that share. The two are consistent by construction: C11 supplies one sign's contribution to the quantity C02 judges. Neither negates the other. C02 defines the criterion; C12 states that the per-sign table is descriptive and carries no criterion. The two are consistent by construction: the table reports the quantities the criterion judges and moves no verdict itself. Neither negates the other.

claims.text: The score is the share of trained signs whose Harappa start rate is at least 0.40.
claims.boundary: The computation claim (spec section 5). A sign's Harappa start rate is the share of its Harappa occurrences, counted through its counterpart glyphs (C08) in the withheld Harappa sequences only, in which it stands in initial position - the first sign of a sequence, so a one-sign sequence's sign stands initial. The share is the count of trained signs at or above 0.40, divided by 2. No model, p-value, interval, or composition adjustment is part of the quantity. It does not govern the pass line (C02) or the zero-occurrence edge (C11).
alternatives: Start rates could be computed over all Yajnadevam sites, pooled with training counts, or adjusted for composition.
falsification_tests: Any Spec 036 product whose share is computed on anything other than the withheld Harappa sequences, or with a start rate defined otherwise than initial occurrences over total occurrences through counterpart glyphs, defeats this claim.

metadata.verdict_rule: start_rate = initial occurrences / total occurrences, per sign, on withheld Harappa sequences only; the score is the share of the 2 trained signs at 0.40 or above.
metadata.boundary_confirmation: C02 defines the pass line; C10 defines the quantity the line applies to (the share of trained signs at or above 0.40). The two are consistent by construction: C10 computes the share C02 judges. Neither negates the other.
